title: fix(app-shell): a view stored with no label is named by its object's plural label, never its qualified name (objectui#12774)
body:
Fixes #12774
Clause-②: no

## What

The object page names a view stored with no `label` by its object's plural label, never by its qualified name. The card's reproduction, the tab of `recheck_gate.default` under a header reading "QA Gates", now reads "QA Gates".

The spec gives a view's `label` no default, and objectstack PR #24013 stopped the server inventing one from the view's `name`. `viewTabLabel` fell back to `view.name || view.id`, so the tab drew the machine name.

## How

- `viewTabLabel` (in `ObjectView.tsx`) takes the fallback text as a parameter. Every caller passes `objectPluralLabel(objectDef)`, computed once per render as `unlabelledViewText`.
- The back-link helper `viewOriginLabel` is folded into `viewTabLabel`. It already fell back to the plural label through its callers, so the rule is unchanged for the link. The desktop tab bar, the mobile view switcher and the record page's way back (`location.state.from`, two call sites) are now named by one function.
- The catalogue lookup for a client-derived view still runs first: a `_views.KEY.label` entry names that view. A served view's label is still drawn as served (objectui#11295 / #11336). Authored labels are unchanged.
- No language-pack key, prop or export is added, so `Clause-②: no`.

## Tests

- New `ObjectView.labelLessViewTab-12774.test.tsx`, 10 cells in en and zh-CN, on the 11295 harness with a real `ViewTabBar`, a real `useObjectLabel` and a real `MetadataCtx`. It covers a label-less served view item, a label-less embedded entry and a label-less client-derived view, which read the plural label (localized in zh-CN). Its controls are a catalogue-translated derived view and an authored label.
- Before the fix: `Tests 6 failed | 4 passed (10)`, for example `expected 'recheck_gate.default' to be 'QA Gates'`.
- Ablation on the committed fix: `view.label || view.name || view.id || unlabelled` gives 6 red and 4 controls green. Restored blob `c2627d4` equals HEAD.
- Neighbouring families (every ObjectView test file, the served-view-label, tab-bar and back-link pins, and `packages/i18n/src/__tests__`) on head `5c885e9`: `Test Files 156 passed (156)`, `Tests 2020 passed | 13 skipped (2033)`.
- Local gates, all exit 0: app-shell type-check, eslint (0 errors), check:changeset-claims, changeset:check, check:test-path-roots, check:spec-symbols, check:new-line-citations, check-changeset-presence, check:i18n-keys, check:i18n-drift, check:i18n-dead-keys.

## Live reading

`e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` booted the published `18.0.0-next.2` backend. Its `/meta/view` still invents labels, serving each label-less entry with its qualified name as the label (`showcase_task.form` served as `"showcase_task.form"`). That is the server before objectstack PR #24013, and a served label is drawn as given, so this backend cannot show the fallback live. NOT MEASURED: live before/after screenshots. The fallback is pinned by the test above.

## Acceptance notes

- Rule chosen: the plural label for every label-less view, default or not. It matches the back-link's existing rule and needs no new key. Two label-less views on one object read alike; an author who wants them apart writes a `label`.
- Outside this PR's surface and not changed:
  - The app header on a `/view/NAME` route titles a label-less view with `humanizeSlug(viewName)`, so `recheck_gate.default` becomes "Recheck Gate.Default" (`AppHeader.tsx`).
  - The metadata-admin view picker in `widgets.tsx` draws the label or the name beside the code name, on purpose.
  - `useNavTargetLabel` leaves a label-less view target unnamed, so its caller decides.
